description.value: Grace of India is a small, intimate Indian restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, founded in 2018 and helmed by a chef with over 25 years of experience drawing inspiration from across the Indian subcontinent. The menu spans tandoori specialties, karahi dishes, lamb, seafood, and a range of vegetarian options, with rotating weekday specials. Online ordering with pickup, delivery, and dine-in is available.
